business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale International Distribution of Acetate Eyeglass Frames

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (unitary national jurisdiction; capital Majuro; corporate administration via the Office of the Registrar of Corporations and its exclusive administrative agent, International Registries, Inc.)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (statutory corporate law modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and the New York Business Corporation Law; constitutional framework influenced by U.S. law; customary law recognized under the RMI Constitution; no civil-law corporate code)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986; Amended Compact 2003) - economic and trade provisions, non-discriminatory treatment of investments
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) (signed 2017; in force) - regional trade and development framework
Pacific Islands Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) (in force) - preferential trade among Pacific Island Forum states

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (BCA), including registered agent and registered office provisions; Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended (PMLFTA); Transparency and Beneficial Ownership (Non-Regulated Companies) Regulations 2020 (TBO Regulations); Banks and Trust Companies Act 2010; Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) AML/CFT Guidelines issued under the PMLFTA; UN sanctions implemented through PMLFTA delegated legislation.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (beneficial ownership details are filed with and maintained by the licensed Registered Agent on a private TBO register; accessible to the RMI Registrar of Corporations, the FIU, and other competent authorities upon lawful request; not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Copy of Directorship/Shareholding Identification (Passport) of each incorporating individual and all UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of origin of the shareholder or beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarial certification followed by consular authentication; the Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolutions and Incumbency Certificate for Pre-Incorporation Banking and Counterparty Due Diligence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding Directors and the licensed RMI Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarial certification followed by consular authentication; no domestic apostille pathway exists for RMI-bound documents)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Source-of-Wealth/Source-of-Funds Declaration for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Depository bank or licensed certified public accountant of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (signed declaration notarized; bank letter issued on bank letterhead and consularly legalized where required by the receiving RMI or offshore bank)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation (post-registration delivery for banking, customs, and counterparty onboarding)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Registrar-certified true copy; consular legalization required only for overseas counterparties; no authentication needed for domestic RMI use)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD at formation for this Low_Risk_Standard wholesale distribution scope: all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners (>=25%), and authorized signatories must be screened against the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Consolidated List, and RMI FIU domestic watchlists/alerts. Any PEP flag (primary PEP, family members, or close associates) automatically triggers enhanced due diligence, requiring documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence and senior-management approval. Re-screening is required at least annually and upon any material ownership, management, or sanction-designation event. The Registered Agent, as a reporting entity under the PMLFTA, must retain all screening records for at least five years and report suspicious transactions to the RMI FIU.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations - name search and reservation must be submitted electronically through a licensed Registered Agent using the International Registries, Inc. (IRI) corporate e-filing system (register-iri.com); the Government of the RMI does not allow direct public self-service name booking.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Roman/Latin characters only; English is the operative administrative language. Non-English names must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet. The name must be distinguishable from all existing registered names; exact matches and near-identical variations (differing only by spaces, punctuation, or a corporate suffix) are rejected. A mandatory corporate designator is required: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Company', 'Limited', or accepted abbreviations ('Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Co.', 'Ltd.').
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Trust, Fiduciary, Fund (requires the entity to obtain a license under the RMI Banks and Trust Companies Act, not applicable to this wholesale entity)
Insurance, Reinsurance, Assurance (requires prior approval/licensing of the RMI Insurance Commissioner)
University, College, Academy, Institute (requires consent of the RMI education authority)
Government, State, Federal, Municipal, Public Authority, Crown (implies governmental connection; prohibited without ministerial consent)
Chamber of Commerce (reserved for recognized representative bodies)
Exchange (in a securities, FX, or digital-asset context; requires financial licensing)
Cooperative, Credit Union, Building Society, Savings and Loan (restricted to licensed depository or cooperative entities)
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity, a protected international organization, or an RMI government body
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: 1) The process is channelled exclusively through the licensed RMI Registered Agent. 2) Upon rejection, the Registrar issues a written refusal with grounds; the applicant may immediately re-file the same name with supplementary justification, or substitute a ranked alternative name, at no additional statutory fee if re-filed within 10 calendar days. 3) Administrative reconsideration may be requested from the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. 4) If reconsideration is denied, a formal appeal may be lodged with the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days under the BCA. 5) In parallel, the applicant should reserve one or two alternative names (each valid 30 days) to protect the incorporation timeline; a reserved name not used within 30 days may be re-reserved upon payment of a fresh fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. A non-resident Business Corporation is not required to lease or staff local commercial premises. The statutory registered office is the physical office of the licensed Registered Agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro or Ebeye) and serves as the company's legal seat for service of process, statutory records, and notices. This agent-based 'virtual office' fully satisfies the BCA for a non-resident wholesale distribution vehicle engaged exclusively in international trading; the Registered Agent must maintain a physical presence and all required corporate and TBO records in the RMI.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Estimated annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection is below 5% for a non-regulated, Low_Risk_Standard wholesale distribution entity. Regulatory inspection activity under the BCA, PMLFTA, and TBO Regulations is directed primarily at the Registered Agent's record-keeping and compliance systems rather than the foreign business address of the company; any inspection of the statutory registered office would be coordinated through the Registered Agent.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), codified in the Republic of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, Title 29 (Associations), Chapter 1; applicable provisions govern the certificate of incorporation, statutory registered office and agent, initial directors, bylaws, and officers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filing administration accepted through RMI-licensed registered agents under the Registrar's delegated service arrangement).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation, executed by the incorporator, notarized, and filed in duplicate together with the registered agent's consent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; par or no-par shares are authorized with zero paid-in capital permitted; no escrow account or capital deposit is required at formation; initial subscribed shares are issued as fully paid and non-assessable pursuant to the first board resolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriptions of the incorporators for the initial authorized capital shares of the Corporation are hereby accepted; such shares are issued as fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, with the licensed registered agent, is hereby adopted as the statutory registered office, and the registered agent is appointed to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following officers are hereby appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, to serve until the next annual meeting; the President is authorized to open bank accounts, appoint signatories, and execute all documents necessary to commence lawful business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (via RMI-licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two ranked corporate name options to the licensed registered agent; the agent conducts a Registrar search against the RMI corporate name index. The selected name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must not contain restricted words such as 'bank' or 'trust' absent a dedicated license. Reserve the approved name for 30 days pending filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing of subscriber entity (where the subscriber is a corporate body)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File with the Registrar a written explanation claiming prior-use priority, or promptly submit an alternative name for re-search and reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and notary public; subsequent submission to the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Certificate of Incorporation in statutory form stating the corporate name, registered office, registered agent, initial directors, authorized share capital (with par value, if any), permitted lawful business purposes, and limitation of liability; the incorporator executes the certificate before a notary; the registered agent countersigns its consent to act.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to a Registrar deficiency notice by executing a corrected certificate and submitting a letter of explanation; invoke the statutory certificate-of-correction procedure within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Payment of Government Incorporation Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (or the registered agent's accredited filing window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Certificate of Incorporation in duplicate with the Registrar; pay the US$300 government incorporation fee through the registered agent's accredited account; receive the certified Certificate of Incorporation bearing the Registrar's seal and date of filing; order the initial Certificate of Good Standing.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney / agent authorization letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct minor irregularities by filing a certificate of correction; if the certificate is rejected, re-file with the Registrar's comments fully addressed; expedited processing is available upon payment of the applicable expedite fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Action: Adoption of Bylaws and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial directors of the Corporation (internal corporate governance action)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first organizational meeting or act by unanimous written consent; adopt the Bylaws; approve the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, adoption of the registered office and registered agent, and appointment of officers; authorize the opening of the corporate bank account and appointment of authorized signatories; record minutes in the corporate minute book and issue share certificates.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution or written consent in lieu of meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Ratify any procedural defect by a subsequent unanimous board or shareholder written consent; no external re-filing is required unless the defect affects the Certificate of Incorporation itself.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Certificates and Commencement of Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and the Corporation's licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the certified Certificate of Good Standing and certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation and register of directors for the banking KYC pack; finalize the corporate bank account opening for Swift/TT and platform-pay rails consistent with the Low-Risk Standard AML classification; if a physical RMI presence is later established, apply to the Tax and Revenue Office for a taxpayer identification number and to the municipal authority for any business license.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request re-issuance of the Certificate of Good Standing; rectify any register discrepancy by board resolution and, where required, file the corrected annual return with the Registrar.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Resources and Development, Republic of the Marshall Islands (trade and industrial licensing), acting jointly with municipal business license offices (e.g., City of Majuro).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License (for foreign-owned physical operations, if any) and/or Municipal General Business License; no sectoral manufacturing or import/export permit applies to the wholesale international distribution of acetate eyeglass frames.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA; category 'Registration Only/Negative Declaration' because the activity is non-manufacturing, non-discharging wholesale distribution with no significant environmental footprint.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluent anticipated. If a bonded warehouse is established: sanitary wastewater only, pH 6.0-9.0, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L and BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L per EPA water quality regulations; packaging and plastic waste managed under the RMI National Solid Waste Management Strategy; no VOC emission threshold applies because acetate frames are stored and distributed without surface treatment or coating.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and fire certificate from the municipal fire and rescue service for any warehouse or office premises; structural load certification per RMI building code for storage areas exceeding the rated uniform live load; occupational health and safety compliance under the Workmen's Compensation Act 1996 for locally engaged employees. No civil-defense or occupational clearance is triggered for a non-resident offshore entity without physical premises in the Marshall Islands.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro (administration of import duty, customs tariff, and travel tax) with official government portal www.rmigovernment.org; Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Majuro (administration of the Business Corporations Act 1990 and issuance of the Company Registration Number). The RMI has no income-tax administration because no direct income tax is imposed at the national level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC): (1) appoint a licensed Registered Agent physically present in the Marshall Islands; (2) file Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990 with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations; (3) pay the statutory filing fee (no minimum capital is required); (4) receive the Certificate of Incorporation and a unique Company Registration Number (CRN), which functions as the entity's official tax-identity number for banking and customs purposes; (5) file the non-resident declaration or undertaking confirming that no business will be conducted within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; (6) if goods are ever physically imported into the RMI, register separately with the Revenue and Taxation Office for an importer/customs code and obtain any municipal business license required by the relevant local government. No separate tax identification number certificate is issued by any RMI tax authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Non-Resident Business Corporation. The entity is statutorily exempt from all RMI direct taxation, including corporate income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and gross receipts tax, on income derived from sources outside the Republic. RMI tax exposure is confined to: (a) customs import duty on goods physically entering the RMI; (b) municipal business license fees if local operations are conducted; and (c) social security contributions only if local employees are engaged. A BC electing resident status would be taxable on RMI-source income only, but the default classification for a non-resident wholesale exporter is full direct-tax exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available in the direct-tax sense. The RMI has no income-tax statute and therefore no check-the-box, hybrid-mismatch, fiscal consolidation, CFC, or PFIC elections. The only relevant statutory status election under the Business Corporations Act 1990 is the resident/non-resident designation: a corporation may file a Notice of Non-Resident Status at incorporation to obtain exempt classification, and a non-resident corporation may later file a Notice of Resident Status to become a resident domestic corporation; both elections take effect upon filing with the Registrar of Corporations. The RMI maintains no double-tax treaties and accords no foreign tax credit mechanisms.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax is imposed in the Marshall Islands. Indirect levies are limited to customs import duty (ad valorem and specific tariffs under the RMI Customs Act and tariff schedule), an airport/travel departure tax, and municipal business license fees. A non-resident BC engaged in cross-border B2B wholesale distribution of acetate eyeglass frames that never enters RMI territory has no indirect-tax nexus with the Republic.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists because no such tax is levied. For customs duty purposes, any person importing goods into the RMI must obtain an importer registration code from the Revenue and Taxation Office; there is no minimum annual turnover threshold, and an export-only wholesale trader operating entirely outside the country is not required to register with any RMI tax authority.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The RMI imposes no electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API connectivity, or digital stamping mandate on suppliers or exporters. The Revenue and Taxation Office uses an ASYCUDA-based customs clearance system at the Majuro port for import declarations, but no electronic invoice reporting or pre-clearance authorization applies to non-resident entities invoicing foreign wholesale customers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the RMI has no VAT/GST system, and therefore the legal concept of zero-rated export supplies, input-VAT refunds, or export incentive refund claims does not exist. A Non-Resident Business Corporation exporting acetate eyeglass frames to wholesale buyers in other jurisdictions simply incurs no RMI indirect tax on those offshore transactions and is not required to file any declaration, election, or refund claim to obtain that exemption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Commercial Invoice issued by the Non-Resident BC to the overseas wholesale buyer
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing outbound movement of goods from the port of export to the foreign buyer
Customs Export Declaration (required only where goods are physically transshipped through RMI territory or cleared from an RMI port)
Inward Remittance Certificate (standard banking evidence of receipt of export proceeds; not a statutory RMI tax document)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable in any VAT-exemption sense, because no zero-rating or refund mechanism exists to abuse. Residual compliance risk is limited to: (a) under the RMI Customs Act, false or fraudulent declarations to customs are punishable by fines up to USD 1,000, forfeiture and confiscation of the goods, and suspension or revocation of the importer registration code; (b) making a false statement or delivering a forged document to the Registrar of Corporations is a misdemeanor punishable by a fine of up to USD 1,000 and imprisonment up to six months; (c) no retrospective direct-tax clawback can arise because non-resident BCs are not assessed on income derived from outside the Republic.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain an independent central bank. The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender, making the U.S. Federal Reserve System the de facto monetary anchor. Domestic banking supervision, AML enforcement, and licensing are carried out by the Banking Commissioner and the Financial Institutions Supervision Section within the RMI Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the Banking Act 1991 and the Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Prevention Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Because the U.S. dollar is the domestic currency and legal tender of the Marshall Islands, there is no foreign-exchange control regime and no legal distinction between current-account and capital-account convertibility. Current account payments for trade-in-goods, freight, insurance, and professional fees are freely transferable. Capital account items, including shareholder equity subscriptions, shareholder loans, intercompany balances, dividends, and repatriation of retained earnings, are also freely convertible and transferable without central-bank licence, form filing, or prior approval. Profit remittance in practice requires only a bank-completed KYC/AML review, OFAC screening, and, where requested for corporate-governance evidence, a certificate of good standing and a board resolution. The non-resident RMI Business Corporation is generally tax-exempt on foreign-source income, so no RMI withholding tax or fiscal foreign-exchange conversion hurdle is imposed on dividend or profit remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: RMI law imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender rule, no repatriation timeline, and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. As the U.S. dollar is the local currency, export receipts are received directly in the same currency of account and may be retained offshore, kept in local RMI banks, or converted into any other currency at the market rate through licensed international correspondent banks. No form, permission, or surrender declaration is required by the RMI government.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD) / Operational Clearing Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Republic of the Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account / Commercial Letter of Credit Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: The Marshall Islands does not maintain a domestic e-money institution (EMI) licensing path; non-bank payment providers may not hold deposits, open escrow accounts, or clear RMI-based treasury flows without a banking licence. Regulated offshore EMIs, including those supervised under UK FCA, Singapore MAS, or Hong Kong MSO frameworks, are viable only as auxiliary payment gateways for marketplace collections, low-value supplier disbursements, and non-bank FX conversion. Their suitability as the primary treasury clearing rail is low because they lack LC issuance capability, direct RMI bank settlement membership, and full audit continuity for capital and trade flows. Feasibility rating: Medium for platform-payment collection, Low for escrow and core trade treasury operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The RMI Business Corporations Act does not statutorily require directors to appear physically in Majuro for account opening. In practice, Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam permit remote corporate onboarding if the documentation package is apostilled or certified, each director and ultimate beneficial owner undergoes a live video interview, and the account signatories submit notarized passport copies, evidence of residential address, source-of-wealth declarations, and professional references. For final activation of high-value outward wires and commercial LC issuance, one authorized representative or director may be asked to complete an in-branch identity-verification visit in Majuro. The account can, however, be opened remotely in a restricted mode to receive inbound capital and verify the corporate structure before such visit occurs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with nominee directors or non-transparent ownership structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate register excerpt, full beneficial-ownership declaration, government-issued photo ID, proof of residential address for each director and owner, certificate of good standing, bank reference letter, source-of-funds statement, and board resolution identifying the commercial and economic substance of the entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity injection from an off-shore financial centre or an individual investor not connected to the trade
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed share-subscription agreement or shareholder loan agreement, audited or reviewed financial statements of the sending entity, sending-bank reference letter, legal-source-of-funds evidence such as asset liquidation or accumulated dividend records, and a sworn declaration confirming beneficial ownership and intended use in optical-frame wholesale trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound trade disbursements to high-risk jurisdictions, especially where invoice routing differs from physical delivery
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed purchase order, final supplier invoice matching the beneficiary bank account, underlying distribution contract, airway bill or ocean bill of lading, customs entry where applicable, freight forwarder confirmation, price-benchmarking documentation, and supplier KYC due-diligence file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency disbursement via e-wallet, PayPal, Payoneer, or platform-payment to developers or suppliers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform underwriting file, per-transaction ledger reconciled to specific eyeglass-frame sales or purchase invoices, marketplace counterparty KYC reports, external auditor confirmation of treasury controls, and segregation of platform funds from corporate operating capital.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections must be sent in U.S. dollars by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder, financing entity, or intercompany lender to the RMI bank account. The preferred clearing route is: originating bank abroad -> U.S. correspondent bank (Fedwire/CHIPS) -> Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam – RMI Branch. The remittance instruction must state 'EQUITY CAPITAL INJECTION – ISIC 4646 OPTICAL FRAMES WHOLESALE' or, where the sending bank requires a Balance of Payments reason code, use OECD/IMF TCS 200.11 for equity capital other than investment-fund shares or TCS 200.15 for non-financial corporate loans. The receiving RMI bank performs OFAC screening, verifies the BC's KYC file, registered number, and authorizing board resolution, and credits the account without RMI central-bank approval or FX registration. A bank deposit confirmation and SWIFT MT103 copy constitute sufficient paid-in-capital verification for auditing and corporate records.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for acetate eyeglass-frame inventory settlement are cleared principally through USD SWIFT MT103 transfers via the bank's U.S. correspondent account. For suppliers requiring documentary security, a commercial letter of credit is issued under SWIFT MT700 by Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam – RMI Branch, with advising/confirming in the supplier's jurisdiction, commonly China, Hong Kong, Italy, or South Korea. The required trade-payment document package includes the commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, and inspection certificate where required. RMI banks do not require an exchange-control permit for outward USD payments; internal AML surveillance thresholds, sanctions screening, and beneficiary-name match checks apply, and SWIFT gpi tracking should be used to obtain real-time clearing status.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable USD/EUR forward contracts with a licensed counterparty bank, used solely to hedge committed EU supplier payables for premium acetate frames.

Non-deliverable or deliverable USD/CNH forwards (DF/NDF) executed through a PRC or Hong Kong licensed bank, with settlement through the RMI bank's USD correspondent, linked to confirmed CNY purchase orders from Chinese frame manufacturers.
USD/CNH cross-currency swaps covering matched annual trade-payable and receivable cycles of the optical-frame wholesale business.
USD/JPY and USD/HKD forward contracts for tangential component imports and customer-denominated receipts, limited to terms of 12 months or less.

Plain-vanilla FX options with bank counterparties, permitted only when an underlying trade receivable or payable is documented and when the transaction is approved under the entity's board-adopted treasury risk policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report to the Registrar of Corporations (disclosing directors, officers, registered agent, registered office and authorized share capital) accompanied by the annual registration fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Corporate Registry (Office of the Attorney General)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; the Marshall Islands applies an anniversary-based filing cycle, not a fixed calendar deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of USD 200 for overdue submissions; delinquency of more than 90 days exposes the corporation to administrative strike-off and loss of good standing; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears plus a restoration fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual continuation of registered agent and registered office (agent consent and office address reconfirmed as part of the Annual Report filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands registered agent (agent appointment is a matter of public record with the Registrar of Corporations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous statutory requirement; reconfirmed each year with the Annual Report on the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a resident registered agent or registered office in the Marshall Islands is a breach of the Business Corporations Act and may result in default notice followed by cancellation of the certificate of incorporation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register refresh and AML/KYC re-certification (including confirmation of any share transfers or changes in ultimate beneficial ownership during the year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent as statutory custodian of the Beneficial Ownership Register (maintained locally; not filed publicly with the Registrar unless requested by competent authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary and within 30 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with the Marshall Islands AML/CFT regulations and beneficial ownership requirements may subject the corporation and its registered agent to monetary penalties and deregistration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act for a non-resident Business Corporation; an audit becomes mandatory only if triggered by the articles of incorporation or bylaws, by shareholder resolution, or by a lender or contractual counterparty
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No locally prescribed accounting framework for non-resident corporations; management may elect IFRS or US GAAP; the corporation must maintain books and records that fairly reflect its financial condition and business operations

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain a beneficial ownership declaration annually and after every transfer of shares; any change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be recorded in the Beneficial Ownership Register within 30 days, and the register must be made available to the Registrar or other competent authority upon lawful demand
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Registered Agent and Registered Office
Beneficial Ownership Register (maintained by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 - statutorily not required for non-resident Business Corporation; voluntary audit typically USD 5,000 - USD 12,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Non-Resident Business Corporation – no Marshall Islands corporate income tax; a domestic corporation with RMI-source income is nominally subject to an 8% net income tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption under the Business Corporations Act: non-resident corporations are wholly exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, branch profit tax, and withholding tax; annual flat government franchise fee replaces any income tax liability

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Registrar of Corporations Annual Confirmation of Exempt Status (Form CRC-EX-1) – filed through the Marshall Islands Online Registry portal of the Registrar of Corporations (MIR)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the corporation’s registration anniversary date; for a calendar-year entity, the practical administrative cutoff is 31 January of the following calendar year, and late filing is subject to automatic default surcharges

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name and Marshall Islands registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered name and number as shown in the certificate of incorporation; a non-resident Business Corporation must use its adopted corporate name, including any 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or other statutory suffix

Select 'Non-Resident Business Corporation' and certify that the corporation has not carried on any trade or business within the Republic of the Marshall Islands and has derived no RMI-source income during the fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and accounting reference date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the fiscal year-end in DD/MM/YYYY format; the RMI imposes no mandatory fiscal year-end for a non-resident BC, but the date must match the financial statements used for any distribution or loan decisions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership and director register declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attest that a current confidential register of directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners is held by the licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands; this register is not publicly accessible but is required for AML/CDD supervision and must be updated on any ownership change

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Defaults trigger a penalty of USD 2,000 plus a daily surcharge of USD 50 for each day of continued failure. The Registrar may also strike the corporation off the register, restore the matter for administrative dissolution, and impose discretionary disqualification orders on directors and officers

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – the Marshall Islands imposes no statutory withholding tax on dividends, distributions, or deemed profit distributions paid by a Non-Resident Business Corporation to its shareholders
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement network exists for the Marshall Islands; therefore, DTA relief is generally unavailable and no TRC-based claim is required in RMI. If a limited maritime/shipping treaty or a future convention applies, the relief protocol is: (1) obtain an RMI Certificate of Non-Residence from the Registrar, (2) submit a standard treaty relief declaration and TRC-equivalent document to the paying agent, (3) retain the declaration with formal counsel, and (4) apply the reduced withholding rate in the source jurisdiction only upon full acceptance
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border IP royalties and debt interest paid by a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation; treaty rates are not applicable because the RMI has no comprehensive tax treaty that covers royalties or interest

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing regime or Local File/Master File threshold in the Marshall Islands; however, Economic Substance Regulations apply to a 'relevant activity' with gross income commencing at USD 1,000,000, requiring demonstrable substance documentation in USD, which is the local currency
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) are applicable. A non-resident Business Corporation carrying on wholesale distribution or a service centre activity must satisfy the economic substance test: core income-generating activity performed in RMI, adequate physical premises, qualified employees, expenditure proportionate to income, and board meetings or management direction conducted in the RMI. Pure nominee structures with no local decision-making are treated as shell arrangements and are subject to penalty and reclassification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Misrepresentation of Non-Resident Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating or managing an ophthalmic eyewear frames wholesale business from high-tax jurisdictions while claiming RMI non-resident tax exemption without holding board meetings, maintaining a substantive registered agent relationship, or performing any core functions in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive reclassification as an RMI-resident corporation, assessment of 8% net income tax plus interest and late-payment penalties, administrative fines up to USD 250,000, nullification of transfer pricing and profit repatriation positions, and mandatory strike-off of the corporate registration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid corporate tax and penalties; the corporate veil is pierced on a finding of sham or fiscal misrepresentation. Travel bans may be imposed by the RMI High Court, and individuals face civil restitution proceedings and imprisonment of up to 7 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a dormant or passive BC with nominee shareholders, no physical RMI presence, no records of economic activity, and no board oversight while using Swift_TT and platform-pay proceeds solely to funnel international sales revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under the Business Corporations Act and Economic Substance Regulations of up to USD 100,000 plus daily penalties of USD 1,000; administrative dissolution; publication of a strike-off notice; inability to enforce contracts or access bank accounts in the corporate name
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners may be personally barred from acting as directors in any RMI entity for up to 10 years; the court may order restoration of all dissipated corporate assets, issue freezing orders, and impose custodial sentences of up to 5 years for deliberate maintenance of a shell vehicle

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Beneficial Ownership and Record-Keeping Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to keep a current confidential register of beneficial owners, allowing the use of bearer shares or undisclosed nominees, or processing trade proceeds through third-party payment platforms without satisfactory source-of-funds verification for acetate eyeglass frame wholesale transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing regime up to USD 500,000, asset freezing orders, revocation of the registered agent’s license, referral to financial intelligence units, and cross-border exchange of information
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and in substance the beneficial owners are personally liable for AML breaches. Sanctions include fines up to USD 250,000, disqualification, travel restrictions, civil restitution, and imprisonment of up to 10 years for wilful money laundering or terrorist financing involvement
